AAPL: buy into the new product cycle.

Apple closed fiscal 2024 with revenue of $412.4 billion, a record, and Services keeps compounding. Gross profit for fiscal 2024 was $180.7 billion. Management is pushing hard on on-device AI and the installed base is large enough to monetise it. Sources say Apple is in advanced talks to acquire a leading AI search start-up, which would accelerate the roadmap. Analysts are broadly bullish into the holiday quarter. We recommend a 500 share position.
